_about: Per subject, read by smoke/smoke.py (a subject not listed takes its DEFAULTS). frame: the frame N its title is judged at (smoke/references/<name>.png is the canvas at N), and where Start is pressed from; key_frames: how long a key is held, the screen compared frame by frame with no key; play: frames of play after Start, before Reset or Power; sound: where its sound window is, 'title' (it sounds on its title: the window follows a click) or 'start' (its title is silent: the window follows Start, pressed for 5 frames at each of sound_starts, frames after N).
